prompt: Elements `[31, 24, 19, 11, 4, 15, 2]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[31, 24, 19, 11, 4, 15, 2]` to `[2, 4, 15, 11, 24, 31, 19]`.
